lines.speaker: SECURITY
lines.zh: 站住！你的手刚才伸到哪儿去了？
lines.en: Stop! Where do you think that hand was going?

lines.speaker: SECURITY
lines.zh: 偷工作证？我看得清清楚楚，别想蒙混过去！
lines.en: Stealing a staff ID? I saw that. Don't try to talk your way out!

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.zh: 糟了……偏偏这时候看过来！
lines.en: Great... You had to look over right then!

lines.speaker: SECURITY
lines.zh: 还想跑？把手放好，跟我去门口。你得离开这家旅馆！
lines.en: Trying to run? Hands where I can see them. To the door. You're leaving this hotel!

lines.speaker: CLEANER
lines.zh: 哎！你往我口袋里摸什么呢？！
lines.en: Hey! What are you doing with your hand in my pocket?!

lines.speaker: CLEANER
lines.zh: 我忙着收拾房间，你倒忙着顺走我的工作证？
lines.en: I'm busy cleaning rooms, and you're busy pinching my staff ID?

lines.speaker: CLEANER
lines.zh: 少来这套！门在那边，赶紧出去，别等我叫保安！
lines.en: Save it! The door's over there. Out, before I call security!

lines.speaker: MANAGER
lines.en: ...Hands off. That is my staff ID.

lines.speaker: MANAGER
lines.zh: 我原以为你是来办理手续的。看来，是我高估了你的礼貌。
lines.en: I thought you were here for the paperwork. I seem to have overestimated your manners.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.zh: 如果我说拿错了……你也不会信吧。
lines.en: You wouldn't believe me if I said it was a mistake... would you?

lines.speaker: MANAGER
lines.zh: 正确。偷窃者不在我们的接待范围内。请立即离开，否则我会请保安送你出去。
lines.en: Correct. We do not accommodate thieves. Leave now, or security will escort you out.
